title: Air National Guard Help Fight Wildfires
description: Package about the Air National Guard helping to fight wildfires in California.

transcript.text: International Guard Air Force Reserve working together for one current cause.
Lieutenant Colonel Roger Williams says the airmen deployed to McClellan airfield in Sacramento
are there to help California contain wildfires burning across the state since June 21st.
The 302nd Air Expeditionary Group's C-130s equipped with modular airborne firefighting
systems for maps fly roughly 20 to 30 sorties a day.
William says this is a great example of how the military is helping to support civilian agencies.
We're minimizing damage to homes and property keeping the fire to a minimum.
According to Williams the size of this mass package is unusual.
I've deployed before two airplane package, four airplane package, but never eight airplane
packages so this is a pretty large package to come here to California.
The maps package includes aircraft from the Wyoming and North Carolina Air National Guard
as well as an Air Force Reserve unit from Colorado Springs.
Regardless of where they came from, Williams explains the airmen are doing what they are
trained to do and they are proud of it.
We're here to help the wildfire throughout the police station.
If the weather's good we'll be flying.
